description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book Caspian Escape:* 6-Seater Golf Cart and 4 Bikes Included* Private Elevator Upon Request (Add'l $100/night)* Steps from Private Beach Access * Across from the Community Pool (Seasonally Heated Oct-March 1)* Rooftop Terrace - Sunset views and cozy nights* Near Redfish Village, Johnny McTighe's Pub, and Blue Mountain Creamery* Miles of Bike Trails; 6 miles to Seaside* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is not available to adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions. *Welcome to Caspian Escape, a stunning 5-bedroom, 5.5-bath luxury beach home nestled within a gated community along scenic 30A. Designed for up to 12 guests, this exquisite retreat combines modern elegance with relaxed coastal charm. Just steps from the sugar-white sands, guests will enjoy effortless access to the beach, the sparkling community pool, and the nearby dining and shopping of Redfish Village.Inside, the open-concept living area features designer furnishings, a cozy fireplace, and a 75" Smart TV—perfect for gathering after a day in the sun. The gourmet kitchen boasts high-end appliances, quartz countertops, a large island, and ample seating for family meals or morning coffee. Multiple balconies throughout the home invite guests to take in the salty breeze and Gulf views, while two laundry rooms offer added convenience for longer stays.The private elevator can be requested for an additional $100/night. This makes moving between floors effortless, and the spacious rooftop terrace sets the stage for unforgettable evenings. Enjoy breathtaking sunsets from the roof top lounge, dine alfresco under the stars, or mix cocktails at the wet bar while listening to the waves in the distance.After a day of coastal adventures, retreat to the elegant primary suite featuring a plush king bed, spa-inspired en suite bath, and private balcony access. Additional guest rooms are thoughtfully appointed for comfort and privacy, including a cozy bunk room and a top-floor Murphy suite perfect for flexible sleeping arrangements.A complimentary 6-seater golf cart and four bikes are provided for easy cruising along 30A’s scenic bike paths. Bed Set-Up:1st FloorGuest Bedroom 1: King Bed2nd FloorMaster Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom 2: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed3rd FloorGuest Bedroom 3: King Bed4th FloorGuest Bedroom 4: Queen Murphy BedArea Attractions: Gulf Front at Blue Mountain Beach Condo is located along the beautiful beaches of South Walton and on Scenic 30A near Grayton Beach, Seaside, and Watercolor. One will find some of the best restaurants and shopping areas of the panhandle, such as Stinky's Bait Shack and Bud and Alley's. The 27-mile bike path provides hours of fun and exercise for the whole family as you ride a safe and easy path from Blue Mountain Beach Condos to shops, art galleries, restaurants, Seaside, Watercolor, Grayton Beach or Topsail State Park, and other beach areas. Bike rentals are available and within walking distance at Big Daddy's Bike Shop. Enjoy a ride-along scenic 30A. Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! You'll have an array of dining options as well!The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
